normSet.name: Global / NORMA 412
publicationRules: A published norm version is immutable.
To change thresholds, clone the published norm into a new draft version.
Every attempt pins the exact normSetVersionId used at final scoring.
Recalculation under another norm creates a new ResultRun and never overwrites historical results.
knownWorkbookNotes: The workbook contains another block labelled xxxGerencial / NORMA 412 that is numerically identical to Global / NORMA 412 in the inspected tables; it is not exported as a separate standard.
The separate Situación Financiera scale norm is present, but the current quadrant formulas use the Salud Financiera norm for the X axis.
Búsqueda de Significado Psicoproductivo and Cuadrantes have an invalid final output value instead of decile 10 and are blocked.
